description: BIGVILLE RUNG 1/3 (block 277000) -- THE HELD BOND update dynamics. Relationships move out of the sim as bare symmetric kin/hates edges and into the agent graph as a per-agent, DIRECTED, subjective, updatable Bond(A->B) with THREE dissociable slots (belief/ToM-decode generalizing bd_mary_infers; six signed relational emotions; one signed approach-avoidance attraction + a romantic sub-value) over a graded tie_strength/band. Seven bond_* rules: belief decode, reciprocity-up, betrayal-down-HARDER (negativity bias + global re-appraisal), third-party gossip weighted by source trust (generalizes bl_badmouth), homophily->attraction (dissimilarity weighs more), proximity->familiarity (contempt caveat), band assignment. Every DECISION is a rule composing existing Terms; the adapter only ingests/arms/reads. Falsifier: update_gain=0 freezes every bond to its static seed prior = the OLD bare-label behavior (mirrors af_choose_action's affect_gain). Composes existing DSL Terms only; ZERO new Rust. OFF by default (self_load_only).

rules.name: bond_belief_infer
rules.comment: BELIEF SLOT (ToM, generalizes bd_mary_infers to any A about any known B): decode B's observed harm signature against THIS bond's held DispositionGenerator codebook (Argmax by -|predicts-observed|) -> belief_disposition + belief_trust. Guarded on update_gain>0 (falsifier) and re-armable via obs_armed.

rules.name: bond_event_benefit
rules.comment: DIRECT dyadic update, reciprocity (A3): a positive appraised event by B toward A raises gratitude/trust/affection/attraction and tie_strength by update_gain*pos_weight*magnitude. One-shot per event (applied). The has_event edge is the grounding trace (A6.3).

rules.name: bond_event_betrayal
rules.comment: DIRECT dyadic update, negativity bias 'bad is stronger than good' (A3): a negative appraised event (loan default, eviction) LOWERS trust+attraction by update_gain*NEG_weight*magnitude (neg_weight > pos_weight -- a TUNABLE knob, no magic ratio), raises resentment/contempt/fear, drops belief_trust, and triggers a GLOBAL re-appraisal (existing affection+gratitude scaled by reappraise_factor<1, not a single decrement). One-shot per event.

rules.name: bond_gossip_update
rules.comment: INDIRECT third-party update (B4, generalizes bl_badmouth/bl_townsfolk_opinion): C tells A about B; A revises Bond(A->B) belief/affect/attraction by update_gain*content_valence*source_trust*gossip_weight -- WITHOUT A directly experiencing B. source_trust = A's trust in C (stamped by the adapter off Bond(A->C)); gossip is EVIDENCE WEIGHTED BY THE SOURCE, never ground truth. One-shot per gossip.

rules.name: bond_similarity_attraction
rules.comment: SIMILARITY/homophily (C1) -> attraction: attribute overlap raises the approach pull; dissimilarity lowers it weighing SLIGHTLY MORE (dissim_weight>sim_weight -- the defensible residue of the repulsion hypothesis, NOT Rosenbaum's refuted strong form). One-shot per arming (sim_armed).

rules.name: bond_proximity_familiarity
rules.comment: PROXIMITY x mere-exposure (C1, B7.1): benign co-presence frequency drifts tie_strength and attraction up -- with the familiarity-breeds-contempt caveat (Finkel 2015): exposure DEEPENS an already-negative attraction. One-shot per arming (prox_armed).

rules.name: bond_band_assign
rules.comment: BAND (B2 spectrum) -- EARNED and INDEPENDENT of affect. Derived PURELY from tie_strength (built by care/cohabitation R2/R6, eroded by betrayal R3), NOT from a genetic edge: an adopted/chosen tie can reach family(5) and a neglected blood tie withers -- 'a step-brother can be MORE kin than kin'. Attraction/resentment do NOT enter the band, so a resented+avoided deep tie keeps its strong band -- 'you do not need to like your kin'. family(5)/intimate(4)/friend(3)/acquaintance(2)/consequential_stranger(1)/stranger(0). Idempotent.
